steps.title: Measure the Smoky Chipotle Ground Beef sauce jar spices
steps.instructions:
Into the Smoky Chipotle Ground Beef sauce jar:
1½ tsp ground cumin
1 tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp dried oregano
Set aside for the produce step.

steps.title: Measure the Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef spice blend
steps.instructions:
Into the Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef spice blend:
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp dried oregano
2 tbsp chili powder
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder

steps.title: Measure the Beef Enchiladas Verdes spice blend
steps.instructions:
Into the Beef Enchiladas Verdes spice blend:
1 tsp ground cumin
½ tsp dried oregano
1 tsp chili powder

steps.title: Measure the Classic Glazed Meatloaf mix-ins bowl
steps.instructions:
Into the Classic Glazed Meatloaf mix-ins bowl:
½ tsp dried thyme
½ cup plain breadcrumbs
1 tbsp brown sugar (for glaze)
Set aside for the sauces and marinades step.

steps.title: Dice all yellow onion
steps.instructions:
Finely dice 4 yellow onions:
1 — into a tub labelled "Finely diced yellow onion — Smoky Chipotle Ground Beef, Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef"
1 — into a tub labelled "Finely diced yellow onion — Smoky Chipotle Ground Beef, Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef"
1 — into the Slow-Cooker Chicken vegetables
1 — into a tub labelled "Classic Glazed Meatloaf — yellow onion and garlic"

steps.title: Mince all garlic
steps.instructions:
Mince all the garlic cloves:
4 cloves for Smoky Chipotle Ground Beef — into the Smoky Chipotle Ground Beef sauce jar
1 clove for Avocado Crema — into a tub labelled "Minced garlic — Avocado Crema, Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef, Beef Enchiladas Verdes +2 more"
3 cloves for Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef — into a tub labelled "Minced garlic — Avocado Crema, Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef, Beef Enchiladas Verdes +2 more"
3 cloves for Slow-Cooker Chicken and Dumplings — into the Slow-Cooker Chicken vegetables
3 cloves for Beef Enchiladas Verdes — into a tub labelled "Minced garlic — Avocado Crema, Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef, Beef Enchiladas Verdes +2 more"
2 cloves for Mexican Rice — into a tub labelled "Minced garlic — Avocado Crema, Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef, Beef Enchiladas Verdes +2 more"
2 cloves for Classic Glazed Meatloaf — into a tub labelled "Classic Glazed Meatloaf — yellow onion and garlic"
1 clove for Buttered Green Beans — into a tub labelled "Minced garlic — Avocado Crema, Tex-Mex Seasoned Ground Beef, Beef Enchiladas Verdes +2 more"

steps.title: Chop all fresh cilantro
steps.instructions:
Roughly chop the cilantro for Avocado Crema and Beef Enchiladas Verdes:
¼ cup for Avocado Crema — into a tub labelled "Chopped fresh cilantro — Avocado Crema, Beef Enchiladas Verdes"
¼ cup for Beef Enchiladas Verdes — into a tub labelled "Chopped fresh cilantro — Avocado Crema, Beef Enchiladas Verdes"

Chop the cilantro for Fresh Pico de Gallo:
¼ cup — into a tub labelled "Fresh Pico de Gallo — fresh cilantro, jalapeño, roma tomatoes and white onion"

Pick the remaining cilantro into sprigs for Warm Corn Tortillas & Garnishes:
½ bunch — into a tub labelled "Warm Corn Tortillas & Garnishes — fresh cilantro"

steps.title: Slice the red onion
steps.instructions: Thinly slice 1 red onion — into a tub labelled "Quick Pickled Red Onions — thinly sliced red onion".

steps.title: Prep all jalapeños
steps.instructions:
Work through the jalapeños one prep at a time:

Thinly slice 1 jalapeño for Warm Corn Tortillas & Garnishes — into a tub labelled "Warm Corn Tortillas & Garnishes — thinly sliced jalapeño"

Seed and mince 1 jalapeño for Fresh Pico de Gallo — into a tub labelled "Fresh Pico de Gallo — fresh cilantro, jalapeño, roma tomatoes and white onion"

Halve 1 jalapeño for Roasted Tomatillo Sauce — into the Roasted Tomatillo Sauce vegetables

steps.title: Dice the roma tomatoes for Fresh Pico de Gallo
steps.instructions: Finely dice 3 roma tomatoes — into a tub labelled "Fresh Pico de Gallo — fresh cilantro, jalapeño, roma tomatoes and white onion".

steps.title: Prep all white onion
steps.instructions:
Finely dice ½ white onion for Fresh Pico de Gallo — into a tub labelled "Fresh Pico de Gallo — fresh cilantro, jalapeño, roma tomatoes and white onion"

Quarter 1 white onion for Roasted Tomatillo Sauce — into the Roasted Tomatillo Sauce vegetables

Finely dice ½ white onion for Beef Enchiladas Verdes — into a tub labelled "Beef Enchiladas Verdes — finely diced white onion"
Finely dice ¼ white onion for Beef Enchiladas Verdes (for garnish) — into a tub labelled "Beef Enchiladas Verdes — finely diced white onion"

steps.title: Shred the iceberg lettuce for Taco Toppings
steps.instructions: Shred 2 cup iceberg lettuce — into a tub labelled "Taco Toppings — shredded iceberg lettuce".

steps.title: Slice the celery for Slow-Cooker Chicken and Dumplings
steps.instructions: Slice 3 celery stalks into rounds — into the Slow-Cooker Chicken vegetables.

steps.title: Slice the carrots for Slow-Cooker Chicken and Dumplings
steps.instructions: Slice 3 carrots into rounds — into the Slow-Cooker Chicken vegetables.

steps.title: Chop the fresh parsley for Slow-Cooker Chicken and Dumplings
steps.instructions: Chop 2 tbsp fresh parsley — into a tub labelled "Slow-Cooker Chicken and Dumplings — chopped fresh parsley".

steps.title: Prep the tomatillos for Roasted Tomatillo Sauce
steps.instructions: Husk and halve 1¼ lb tomatillos — into the Roasted Tomatillo Sauce vegetables.

steps.title: Prep the poblano peppers for Roasted Tomatillo Sauce
steps.instructions: Halve and seed 2 poblano peppers — into the Roasted Tomatillo Sauce vegetables.

steps.title: Trim the green beans for Buttered Green Beans
steps.instructions: Trim the stem ends from 12 oz fresh green beans — into a tub labelled "Buttered Green Beans — trimmed fresh green beans".

steps.title: Finish the Smoky Chipotle Ground Beef sauce jar
steps.instructions:
Smoky Chipotle Ground Beef sauce jar (ground cumin, smoked paprika, dried oregano and garlic already in it): add
2 chipotle peppers in adobo, minced
1 tbsp adobo sauce
Stir to combine.

steps.title: Finish the Classic Glazed Meatloaf mix-ins bowl
steps.instructions:
Classic Glazed Meatloaf mix-ins bowl (dried thyme, plain breadcrumbs and brown sugar already in it): add
1 tsp apple cider vinegar (for glaze)
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
2 tbsp ketchup (mixed into meat)
3 tbsp ketchup (for glaze)
Whisk to combine.
